audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart hands Jax levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items while the whys under those rows describe Gragas winning them (whys[1] out-sustains his Leap Strike poke, whys[5] calls first item 'your peak — force every all-in here').
audit.why: 53.82% over 706 games, a favoured lane. Packet chart: Skill, Gragas, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Jax — matching the existing explanations, including Jax only reclaiming it at 2+ items with Grandmaster's Might.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill, Gragas, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Jax, flipped as one atomic group across both layers.

audit.why: Spikes match the kits: Gragas at 2 (Drunken Rage 5s, Barrel Roll 10/9/8/7/6s), at 6 (Explosive Cask 100/85/70s) and at first item; Jax reclaims it at 2+ items with Grandmaster-at-Arms (110/100/90s) resistances.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] says Counter Strike dodges 'your auto and Q'. Riot's text is 'dodge all incoming attacks' — basic attacks. Barrel Roll's explosion is ability damage and is not dodged by it.
audit.why: This changes how the player fights it: he should keep casting Q into an active Counter Strike and simply withhold autos and the Body Slam commit until the stun fires.
audit.corrected: Hold Counter Strike to dodge your autos — it does not stop Barrel Roll — then stun you mid-combo.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] ('Fight him even late') carries a description about burning a cooldown that belongs to a different entry entirely and names no real number.
audit.why: Counter Strike is 17/15/13/11/9s, so at rank 5 the punish window is only nine seconds; Grandmaster-at-Arms adds Armor and Magic Resist on top, which is what makes late even fights lost.
audit.corrected: Counter Strike runs 9s at rank 5 and his R adds armour and MR.

audit.why: Both packet suspectNames are false positives — 'Explosive Cask' and 'Counter Strike' are the real Riot names; the near-miss was against the lowercase forms.

edits.before: Hold Counter Strike to dodge your auto and Q, then unload the stun mid-combo when you commit
edits.after: Hold Counter Strike to dodge your autos — it does not stop Barrel Roll — then stun you mid-combo

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Counter Strike runs 9s at rank 5 and his R adds armour and MR.

notes: Level chart was inverted against the packet chart and its own explanations on a 53.82% favoured lane; flipped as one atomic group in both layers, unchanged rows included so the group is complete. Counter Strike dodging 'attacks' is stated as basic attacks per Riot's wording — Barrel Roll's explosion is ability damage; marked Medium confidence because the kit's needsResearch is empty and the file cannot confirm ability-damage behaviour outright. Both packet suspectNames are false positives.
